test_contextlog: test the contextlog function that mocks HTTP POST with responses and verifies no env field in request body
build_responses_mock: build an HTTP mock using responses.activate decorator and responses.add to stub external API calls
test_django_api: test a Django API endpoint using business_client.get and assert status code 200
verify_http_call_count: verify the number of HTTP calls to a mocked URL using responses.assert_call_count
inspect_mock_request_body: inspect the body of a recorded mock request using responses.calls and json.loads
